tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud dang man ngag 'chad tshul gyi zin bris bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ya/ spyir khrid gang 'chad kyang mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dpyad bsgom gyi dbang du byas nas bshad bsgom cha mnyam pa'i bar skabs su byon pa'i lam 'bras pa ngor pa yab sras rnams lta bu/ tshul gyi khrid lugs gcig dang / /ku sa li 'jog bsgom gyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa bsdus pa sngon gyi lam 'bras pa chen po rnams lta bu/ dang bsgom pa gtso bor byas te nyams skye khrid kyi lugs su byas pa'i khrid lugs gcig dang / bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i dbang du byas nas khrid mang po lung ma khrid kyi sgo nas thob khrid gcig nyams khrid kyi tshul du thob nas khrid tshul mi 'dra ba mang po lung ma khrid du nod pa lta bu/ khrid du byas pa'i khrid lugs gcig ste khrid 'chad lugs la mi 'dra ba gsum 'byung ba bzhin du/ rgyud kyi bshad pa bya tshul la yang spros pa la dga' ba paṇḍi ta'i bshad lugs sngon gyi 'brog mi lo tsa ba dpon slob rnams dang sa skya pa gong ma yab sras dngos slob rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams lta bu/ kyi dbang du byas nas rgyud gang 'chad kyang / rgyud de dang de'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi tshig don/ 'phros don dka' gnad dang bcas dpon slob gnyis kas bskyar bshad zin thun du byas nas 'chad pa'i lugs gcig dang / yang spros pa la mi dga' ba rnal 'byor ku sa li'i bshad lugs kyi dbang du byas nas rgyud kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi tshig don rnams la lung bshad dang / dka' gnad dang bsdus don rnams dpon slob gnyis kas bskyar bshad kyi sgo nas 'chad pa'i lugs gcig dang / bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i dbang du byas nas ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya/ na bza' brag phug pa'i drung du chos rje bla mas rgyud gsum gsan tshul/ rje kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pa'i rgyud bshad sngon 'gro'i zin bris las 'byung ba lta bu/

las 'phro can don gnyer mchog dang ldan pa rnams rgyud kyi 'chad nyan dpon slob gnyis kas bskyar bshad zin thun sogs kyi gtan la 'bebs rung ba tsam la dgongs nas/ rgyud mang po'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi tshig don thams cad lung bshad kho nas 'chad pa'i lugs gcig dang bcas pa'i rgyud 'chad lugs kyang / lung rgyun tsam gyis kyang rgyud kyi bshad lung gi rgyun mi 'chad pa la dgongs nas mnga' ris pa'i tshig 'grel/ dge chu ba'i dka' 'grel/ gnyan gyi mu tig phreng ba sogs rje sa chen gyi bka' 'bum gyi khrod du bzhugs su gsol ba lta bu/ mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa lags so/ /zhes pa'i 'di bla ma rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub sogs/ brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsung dang / rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa'i gnad blangs te snyoms las pas kun dga' mchog ldan gyi/ yi ger bkod pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ /'di lta bu'i rgyud dang man ngag 'chad tshul gyi yig chung khyad par can 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung bzhin/ de'i dngos kyi slob ma rje kun dga' mchog ldan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa las/ dus phyis sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpe chung 'di'i ma dpe lag tu byung bas de ma thag dad pa dang spro ba khyad par can skyes pa'i dbang gis zhal bshus zhus dag bgyis pa'o/ /ka lyā na wa dhantu// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rgyud dang man ngag 'chad tshul gyi zin bris/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
